'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello, mercenary. I had an acquaintance named Dima. He worked as a sniper in many hot zones. Once he told me: "Anyone can pull a trigger, but only a few can become a true Sniper". Even if that's true, knowing how to work with bolt-action rifles won't hurt in Tarkov. And I don't mind encouraging you to develop that skill. Take out your opponents, and I'll reward you for it.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate any 15 targets without dying while using a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000 [[EXP]]
* +4 [[Bolt-action Rifles|Bolt-action Rifles skill]] levels
* +4 [[Troubleshooting|Troubleshooting skill]] levels
* [[Mechanic]] Rep '''<font color="green">+1.5</font>'''
* 400,000 Roubles
** 420,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 460,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* Unlocks purchase of [[4.6x30mm FMJ SX]] at [[Mechanic]] LL4
* 3x [[4.6x30mm FMJ SX ammo pack (40 pcs)]]
{{quote|Honestly, I even started to doubt my own idea a little, but you handled everything. Here's the reward I promised.}}

==Failure Dialogue==
{{quote|An experienced sniper will not give himself away like that. Catch your breath and try again.}}

==Guide==
The kill objective can still fail through dying after completing it.
